title: Polynomial-time randomized machine class
statement: For a function $p: bn\to\bbq$, let $\mathrm{RP}_{p}$ be the union, over all exponents $e\in\bbn$, of the languages $L$ for which there are a constant $K\in\bbn$ and a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols that decides $L$ with the preceding one-sided error guarantees within time $K(n^e+1)$ on inputs of length $n$, using threshold $p(n)$.
hypotheses_covered: Existence of a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
